headline: Lagos Food Prices Surge in October Despite Slower National Inflation
summary: Major staple foods in Lagos, including maize, ogbono, and garri, saw sharp price increases in October 2026 despite a month-on-month decline in Nigeria's national food inflation rate.
why: Food inflation is the largest component of Nigeria's headline consumer price basket and a key determinant of central bank interest rate policy.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Localized food price surges in Nigeria's commercial capital complicate national disinflation expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
